purpose: Establish the input/output contract and architectural requirements for the T8 Decision Engine.

T1.status: project task; native output inventory required

T2.target: first valid P1-P5 priority strictly after Creation and within 24h

T3.status: project task; native output inventory required

T4.native_output: ranked assignee candidates with retrieval scores

T7.target: first post-Creation RESOLVED event with right-censoring preserved

requirements.input: Validated native task outputs and evidence from T1-T7. Inputs must retain their original task semantics.
requirements.output: Machine-generated structured triage recommendation, rather than only exposing evidence to a human.
requirements.human_role: Human remains able to review or override the recommendation; human review is not the substitute for producing a recommendation.
requirements.fusion_principle: Task outputs must not be blindly concatenated or numerically combined when their semantics differ.
requirements.missingness: Unavailable task evidence remains unavailable and must not be interpreted as negative evidence.

priority_recommendation.description: Recommended priority when sufficient evidence exists

assignment_recommendation.description: Recommended assignee/team from validated candidate evidence

duplicate_recommendation.description: Duplicate indication based on validated duplicate evidence

overall_triage_recommendation.description: Structured machine-generated triage recommendation based on the available decision-specific evidence.

architecture.current_completed_layer: T8 Fusion Investigation: tested whether native task evidence could be fused robustly.
architecture.new_layer: T8 Decision Engine: converts validated task-specific evidence into actionable machine-generated triage recommendations.
architecture.not_a_requirement: A single universal scalar score representing the entire ticket.
architecture.required_behavior: Produce decision-specific recommendations while preserving the semantic meaning of each task's evidence.
